name: io.github.Sushegaad/iso27001-mcp
description: ISO 27001 compliance workspace for Claude. Risks, policies, SoA, evidence, and audit workflows.

environmentVariables.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 32-byte hex key for AES-256 SQLite encryption (generated by iso27001-mcp init)

environmentVariables.name: HMAC_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: 32-byte hex secret for HMAC-signing API keys (generated by iso27001-mcp init)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for authenticating tool calls (generated by iso27001-mcp keygen)

environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the encrypted SQLite database file

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: List ISO 27001 controls with optional filters: version, theme, control_type, new_in_2022, cybersecurity_concept, and pagination.

tools.name: search_controls
tools.description: Full-text search across control names, descriptions, and guidance using the FTS5 index.

tools.name: get_control_attributes
tools.description: Retrieve the 2022 attribute tags for a control: information_security_properties, cybersecurity_concepts, operational_capabilities, security_domains.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Show the mapping relationship between a 2013 control and its 2022 equivalent(s), or vice versa.

tools.name: list_clause_requirements
tools.description: List ISO 27001:2022 clause requirements (clauses 4–10), optionally filtered by parent clause.

tools.name: create_gap_assessment
tools.description: Create a new gap assessment against ISO 27001:2022 or 2013 controls for a defined ISMS scope.

tools.name: update_control_status
tools.description: Set the implementation status of a control within a gap assessment (implemented, partial, not_implemented, na, not_started). Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview changes without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_gap_assessments
tools.description: List gap assessments filtered by status (active, archived, all).

tools.name: export_gap_report
tools.description: Export a full gap assessment report in markdown, CSV, or JSON format.

tools.name: generate_remediation_roadmap
tools.description: Generate a prioritised remediation roadmap from a gap assessment, grouped by risk level and theme.

tools.name: archive_gap_assessment
tools.description: Archive a completed or superseded gap assessment with an optional reason.

tools.name: create_risk
tools.description: Register a new information security risk with asset, threat, vulnerability, likelihood (1–5), and impact (1–5).

tools.name: update_risk
tools.description: Update mutable fields of an existing risk (asset, threat, vulnerability, likelihood, impact, owner, status, related_controls). Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview a field-level diff without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_risks
tools.description: List risks with optional filters: risk_level, status, owner, and pagination.

tools.name: create_treatment_plan
tools.description: Create a risk treatment plan (mitigate, accept, avoid, or transfer) with owner, due date, and optionally residual risk scores.

tools.name: update_treatment_status
tools.description: Update the status and evidence reference for an existing risk treatment plan. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview changes without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: generate_risk_register
tools.description: Export the full risk register in markdown, CSV, or JSON format with optional level/status filters.

tools.name: create_policy
tools.description: Generate a new ISMS policy document from a Mustache template using organisation_name, scope, owner, and effective_date. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview what will be created without writing; pass confirmed=true to generate and save the policy.

tools.name: update_policy
tools.description: Create a new version of an existing policy with scope/owner changes, reviewed_by, and change_summary. Requires admin role. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the version bump and metadata diff without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_policies
tools.description: List policies with optional filters: status, type, owner, overdue_only, and pagination.

tools.name: generate_soa
tools.description: Generate a Statement of Applicability from a gap assessment, pre-populating inclusion/exclusion for all controls.

tools.name: update_soa_entry
tools.description: Update an SoA entry's inclusion status, justification, implementation status, and responsible party. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview changes without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: export_soa
tools.description: Export the Statement of Applicability in markdown or CSV format.

tools.name: create_audit
tools.description: Create an internal ISMS audit record with auditor, planned date, and controls/clauses in scope. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the audit record without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: record_finding
tools.description: Record an audit finding (NC, observation, or OFI) against a clause or control. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the finding without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: create_corrective_action
tools.description: Create a corrective action request (CAR) linked to an audit finding with owner and due date. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the CAR without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: update_corrective_action
tools.description: Update a corrective action's status, root cause, evidence reference, or effectiveness verification.

tools.name: generate_audit_report
tools.description: Export an audit report including findings and CAR status in markdown or JSON format.

tools.name: register_evidence
tools.description: Register an evidence artefact linked to a control with type, source URL, collector, and optional expiry date. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the evidence record without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List evidence records for a control, optionally filtered by status (current, stale, expired).

tools.name: verify_evidence
tools.description: Record an independent verification of an evidence artefact: reviewer (must differ from the collector), verification_status (verified | rejected), sufficiency (required when verified), and an optional assertion. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: link_jira_ticket
tools.description: Link an evidence record to an existing Jira ticket by key, or create a new ticket from a summary.

tools.name: link_github_issue
tools.description: Link an evidence record to an existing GitHub issue by number, or create a new issue from a title and body.

tools.name: query_audit_log
tools.description: Query the tamper-evident audit log with optional filters: date range, tool, outcome, role, key_hash, actor_type (ai | human | system).

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys with their metadata (label, role, status, expiry). Never returns key hashes.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by label, preventing all future use.

tools.name: set_organization_profile
tools.description: Upsert the singleton organization profile (legal name, jurisdiction, ISMS scope, RACI roles). Used by create_policy and create_procedure to auto-inject org defaults.

tools.name: create_procedure
tools.description: Generate a new ISMS procedure document from a Mustache template. Optionally links to a parent policy. Falls back to org profile for organisation_name and scope if not supplied.

tools.name: update_procedure
tools.description: Archive the current procedure version and re-render with updated fields, incrementing the version number. Requires admin role. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the version bump and metadata diff without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: List procedures with optional filters: procedure_type, status, policy_id, overdue_only, and pagination.

tools.name: export_procedure
tools.description: Export a procedure as a markdown document (with related controls appended) or as structured JSON.

tools.name: create_management_review
tools.description: Schedule a new management review (ISO 27001:2022 Clause 9.3) with title, date, and reviewers list.

tools.name: record_review_input
tools.description: Record one of the 7 mandatory Clause 9.3.2 input categories for a management review. Upserts on re-submission; advances status to in_progress on first input.

tools.name: record_review_output
tools.description: Record a Clause 9.3.3 output decision (improvement_decision or isms_change_decision) for a management review.

tools.name: complete_management_review
tools.description: Mark a management review as completed. Enforces ISO 27001:2022 §9.3.2: all 7 input categories must be recorded, and at least one output must be present. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview review readiness (inputs recorded vs. missing, output count) without writing; pass confirmed=true to finalise.

tools.name: list_management_reviews
tools.description: List management reviews with optional status filter and pagination.

tools.name: create_improvement_opportunity
tools.description: Register a proactive improvement opportunity (ISO 27001:2022 Clause 10.1) with source, priority, owner, and optional target date. Not linked to a nonconformity.

tools.name: update_improvement_opportunity
tools.description: Advance an improvement opportunity's status (forward-only: open → in_progress → implemented → closed) or update owner, target date, priority, or description.

tools.name: list_improvement_opportunities
tools.description: List improvement opportunities with optional filters (status, source, priority, review_id) and a backlog health rating (excellent/good/fair/needs_attention/at_risk).

tools.name: generate_evidence_document
tools.description: Render one of 6 Mustache evidence templates (access_review_attestation, training_acknowledgement, supplier_security_questionnaire, incident_post_mortem, bcp_test_report, risk_treatment_sign_off) with org-profile auto-injection. Returns rendered Markdown and simultaneously registers an evidence record.

tools.name: list_evidence_documents
tools.description: List generated evidence documents with optional filters: template_type, generated_by, control_id, and pagination.

tools.name: import_risks
tools.description: Bulk-import risks from a CSV string. Supports dry_run=true for validation preview. Headers: asset, threat, vulnerability, likelihood (1–5), impact (1–5), owner, status, related_controls (semicolon-separated).

tools.name: import_control_statuses
tools.description: Bulk-update control implementation statuses in a gap assessment from a CSV string. Supports dry_run=true for validation preview. Headers: control_id, status, notes, na_justification.

tools.name: set_risk_methodology
tools.description: Upsert the organisation's singleton risk methodology: likelihood/impact scales, calculation method, risk level bands, acceptance threshold, escalation rules, and review frequency. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview the diff against the current methodology without writing; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: record_risk_acceptance
tools.description: Record a risk owner's decision to accept or reject residual risk (ISO 27001:2022 §6.1.3), freezing inherent/residual scores and the acceptance threshold at decision time. Requires residual scores on the treatment plan when one is referenced; accepting an above-threshold residual demands a substantive rationale. Omit confirmed or pass confirmed=false to preview; pass confirmed=true to commit.

tools.name: list_risk_acceptances
tools.description: List recorded risk acceptance decisions with optional filters (risk_id, decision) and pagination.
